name: Imperva Incapsula Event Collector v2
description: Collects CEF security, DDoS, and traffic access logs from Imperva Incapsula Cloud WAF into Cortex XSIAM datasets.
author: Prima Secondary Ramadhan
useCases: Continuously ingest Imperva Incapsula Cloud WAF security and access logs into Cortex XSIAM.
Monitor web application security, bot traffic, and DDoS mitigation events in real-time.
Inspect Imperva log index and fetch status with automatic state management.
